relevance_decisions.name: go-api-contracts
relevance_decisions.reason: Tests exercise established README contracts; no exported API or supported external contract is created or changed.

relevance_decisions.name: go-core-style
relevance_decisions.reason: Writing Go tests; used idiomatic errors, formatting, atomic/channel synchronization, and explicit goroutine ownership.

relevance_decisions.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
relevance_decisions.reason: Production interfaces, concrete dependencies, constructors, options, wiring, and lifecycle contracts stay unchanged. The added lifetime controls are private test fixtures.

relevance_decisions.name: go-package-boundaries
relevance_decisions.reason: Existing module and external test package are retained; no responsibility, import direction, or package boundary change.

relevance_decisions.name: go-test-isolation
relevance_decisions.reason: Repairing guessed readiness and adding timer, goroutine, cancellation, filesystem fixture, cleanup-order, and parallel focused-selection tests.
